3	Reference semantics reproduced (``A.log2_()``):
4	  * ``log2`` is written back into ``A`` storage and the same tensor object is

16	  1. contiguous            -> flat kernel, unit stride

22	staged element -- the compiler reports UB overflow above 64 KiB of staged tile

24	The unmasked kernel takes no length argument: every size that reaches it is an

4	  * ``y != y``    -> NaN   (aten precedence: checked before the zero rule)
5	  * ``self == 0`` -> +0.0  (even for y == 0, y < 0, y == +-inf)
6	  * otherwise     -> ``float(self) * log(y)``
7	  * output dtype/shape always follow ``other``; ``other`` is never mutated.

9	For ``self != 0`` the two special cases collapse into plain IEEE arithmetic
10	(``s * log(NaN)`` is already NaN, and the ``self == 0`` arm is unreachable), so
11	the timed path is one fused multiply-by-log.  For ``self == 0`` the
12	transcendental is compiled away and only the NaN positions of ``y`` survive.
